body:
Most mid-career professionals don't stall for lack of talent. They stall because they've only ever done one thing. 

The fix, in four steps: 
1. Learn the basics: business models, P&Ls, unit economics 
2. Build something: pick a product, package it, sell it 
3. Meet people who are where you want to be 
4. Learn to build with AI 

Ascend, Mesa's Hybrid PGP in Business, AI & Entrepreneurship, puts all four into 12 months of weekends. For professionals with 5+ years of experience. Apply now.
headline: Grow beyond one function
